data.title: 伊井野弥子 · 居室地毯的毛绒连帽衫小憩
data.description: 私人公寓温馨的客厅内，地上铺着厚实的浅灰色羊毛地毯。弥子脱去严谨的风纪委员正装，只穿着一件极其宽大的毛绒连帽开衫与棉短裤，盘腿坐在茶几旁。过长的袖子完全遮住了小手，棕色低双马尾披在肩前。她怀里抱着大号的熊玩偶，双颊泛着淡淡红晕，嘴里含着草莓棒棒糖，眼神中透着平日极难见到的娇憨与全心依恋。
data.action: sitting cross-legged on fluffy living room rug hugging teddy bear, oversized fuzzy hoodie slipping off shoulder, long sleeves covering hands, chewing lollipop, shy tender gaze at viewer
data.location: warm cozy modern apartment living room with fairy lights
data.lighting: soft warm floor lamp and fairy lights casting gentle golden hues
data.mood: intensely adorable gap-moe, sweet domestic comfort
data.promptProse: Sitting cross-legged on a fluffy carpet in an oversized fuzzy hoodie slipping off one shoulder, Miko Iino hugs a teddy bear. Her brown low twintails rest across her chest as she blushes adorably with warm, gentle eyes.
data.animaCaption: Miko sitting on a rug hugging a teddy bear in an oversized hoodie, blushing cutely.
